## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.1f111551"></a>**1. The unit's only source file, http-exception.filter.ts, defines the exported HttpExceptionFilter class, which implements NestJS's ExceptionFilter interface and is decorated with @Catch() so it handles every exception raised in the application.**
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:1-8`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L1-L8)
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:24-25`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L24-L25)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.4bfeab06"></a>**2. The filter builds an ErrorResponse object carrying the status code, message, an ISO-8601 timestamp, the request URL as path, and the request's requestId when present.**
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:43-49`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L43-L49)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.bda5b518"></a>**3. The filter logs every caught exception through a NestJS Logger named 'ExceptionFilter', recording requestId, userId (defaulting to 'anonymous'), method, url, statusCode, error message, stack trace, and the request body, query, and params.**
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:26-26`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L26-L26)
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:51-64`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L51-L64)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.2b8aaaa3"></a>**4. HttpExceptionFilter is registered as a global filter in backend/src/main.ts, which imports it at line 9 and instantiates it in bootstrap via app.useGlobalFilters(new HttpExceptionFilter()).**
  [`main.ts:9-9`](../../../main.ts#L9-L9)
  [`main.ts:67-67`](../../../main.ts#L67-L67)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.8ad937c6"></a>**5. The catch method derives the response status from the exception: an HttpException contributes its own status via getStatus(), while any other exception maps to HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.**
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:33-36`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L33-L36)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.fcc49163"></a>**6. The catch method derives the response message from the exception: an HttpException contributes exception.message, while any other exception maps to the literal 'Internal server error'.**
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:38-41`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L38-L41)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.af259114"></a>**7. The filter sends the error response to the client with response.status(status).json(errorResponse).**
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:66-66`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L66-L66)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.afca5efd"></a>**8. The unit exports an ErrorResponse interface with required statusCode: number, message: string, and timestamp: string fields and optional path?: string and requestId?: string fields.**
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:11-17`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L11-L17)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-filters.4e746b8d"></a>**9. The unit defines a non-exported RequestWithContext interface that extends Express's Request with optional requestId?: string and userId?: string fields.**
  [`http-exception.filter.ts:19-22`](../http-exception.filter.ts#L19-L22)
